briefs.topic: AI automation for service business owners
briefs.audience: small agency founders and service business owners
briefs.monetization_goal: generate qualified leads for an AI automation consulting offer
must_use_points: Open with the hidden cost of manual operations.
Show a simple before/after workflow transformation.
End with a soft CTA for a free automation audit checklist.
avoid: Do not promise guaranteed revenue or guaranteed savings.
Do not use celebrity likeness, brand logos, copied music, or third-party clips.
source_notes: Use owned graphics, simple workflow diagrams, and original narration only.

briefs.audience: urban food lovers, young professionals, and friend groups
must_use_points: Show ambience, food, and group experience without overexplaining.
avoid: Do not use competitor footage or copyrighted music.
Do not claim unrealistic offers or guaranteed availability.
source_notes: Use original restaurant footage or licensed stock placeholders only.

briefs.topic: fitness coach myth about fat loss
briefs.audience: busy beginners trying to lose fat without extreme diets
must_use_points: Open by challenging a common fat-loss myth.
End with a low-pressure coaching CTA.
avoid: Do not promise guaranteed weight loss.
Do not use before/after body images without consent.
source_notes: Use general educational language and avoid medical diagnosis or guarantees.

briefs.audience: early-stage SaaS founders and product marketers

Close with a workshop CTA after delivering value.
avoid: Do not name private client data.
